headline: Silver Falls 2.1 Percent to $49.65 as Precious Metals Give Up the Bid
narrative: Silver fell 2.1 percent to $49.65, money leaving the precious-metals pipe. Gold fell 0.88 percent to $3,934.50, and that same pipe sold with silver. Copper fell 2.12 percent to $6.40, so the industrial-metals pipe moved with the precious complex.
author: jordan
